definitionZh: 最大块大小的 CSS 属性指定一个元素的最大大小,其方向与书写模式指定的书写方向相反。 也就是说,如果书写方向是水平的,那么最大块大小等于最大高度;如果书写方向是垂直的,最大块大小等于最大宽.
sourceDefinition: The max-block-size CSS property specifies the maximum size of an element in the direction opposite that of the writing direction as specified by writing-mode. That is, if the writing direction is horizontal, then max-block-size is equivalent to max-height; if the writing direction is vertical, max-block-size is the same as max-width.
